reason: Fresh green chutney is already made fresh at home in our dabba for practically free, so paying ₹99 for a packaged tube feels completely unnecessary.
objection: My mother or cook already makes fresh green chutney in a dabba for free, and it tastes better.
would_change_my_mind: Unique fusion flavors that cannot be easily made at home, like Schezwan or Tandoori, at a student-friendly price.
